test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: From a point O, Mohita started walking and covered a distance of 30 m in the west direction. She then turned to her left and covered a distance of 15 m. She then took a left turn and travelled a distance of 10 m. Finally, she turned to the left and covered a distance of 15 m. How far and in which direction is she now from the starting point O? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
**Given:**

 
• Mohita starts walking from point O.
 
• She covered a distance of 30 m in west direction.
 
• She then turns left and cover a distance of 15 m.
 
• Then took a left turn and travel a distance of 10 m.
 
• Finally, she tooks left and cover a distance of 15 m.**​**
